description: mega-loop terminal companion reflexes. The engine's gate is the only pass/fail (design 56 rule 1): NO hook ever scores a fix. restore-connection re-injects the repo's saved project so you connect once, not every session; gate-on-stop blocks 'done' while a fix is open and tells the agent to run the ENGINE gate verb (the agent judges via the engine, not the hook) — and steps aside for a stale (>24h) marker so an abandoned fix never nags forever.
